coverageNote: Public standings checked November 1 at 7:56 pm EST (November 2, 00:56 UTC). Two-week comparisons use the saved October 19 baseline for continuously tracked entries. Final medals follow the private evaluation.
dek: Less than 24 hours remain. Chen has the lead, Tufa is giving chase, and fourth place hangs on thirteen hundredths of a point.

headline: Down to the Wire: Chen leads as NVARC3 squeezes past Turducken

image.alt: Illustration for Down to the Wire: Chen leads as NVARC3 squeezes past Turducken. Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model: rank 1, score 75.56; Tufa Labs: rank 2, score 70.24.
image.caption: Score panel: Nov 1, 2026 · 7:56 PM EST; provisional public standings.

sections.heading: A sliver of daylight
sections.text: NVARC3 has fourth place by a whisker. Its Sunday surge from eighth carried it past Team Turducken, 56.15 to 56.02, leaving just 0.13 between them. Six points gained, four places climbed, and suddenly the chase behind the leaders looks very different. Third-placed xz is next on 58.59.

sections.heading: Chen sets the pace
sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model enters the final day on 75.56, with Tufa Labs on 70.24. Chen’s advantage is a little over five points. The pair have opened a wide gap over the chasing pack, but there is still a full day’s worth of pressure to absorb. Across on ARC-2, their positions are reversed: the two leading contenders have a contest apiece to defend.

sections.heading: The field keeps moving
sections.text: Yukai Liu supplied the newest jolt, jumping from 671st to 39th as six more points lifted the score to 36.96. Earlier, UNK climbed into the gold places and now stands 17th on 41.00. K.nosaka, tomo11111 and Luxshan Thavarasa also charged into the top hundred on Sunday.

sections.heading: The long climb
sections.text: yktori has risen from 34th to seventh over the past two weeks, adding 15.01 points. UNK has climbed from 111th to 17th with a gain of 7.81. Near the public gold line, the margins are brutally small: The ARChitects is 16th on 41.03, UNK has 41.00, and Vineeth Sai Varikuntla follows on 40.98. The gold places run through 20th in a field of 5,035 teams.

sections.heading: One day to answer
sections.text: The deadline is Monday at 23:59 UTC, or 6:59 p.m. Eastern. Chen has the lead to protect, Tufa has the gap to close, and NVARC3 and Turducken are almost shoulder to shoulder. The final day begins with plenty still within reach.
